title: 1978-10-10_SECTION_016_276.txt
concise_summary: PKD establishes his 2-74 mystical breakthrough as essentially Neoplatonic (not Gnostic), demonstrating that his involuntary ascent through ontological realms constitutes anamnesis—a recovery of the soul's ability to perceive essences and morphological reality rather than mere spatiotemporal accidents. He maps this perceptual revolution onto Plotinus's hierarchical metaphysics, arguing that schizophrenia itself is a cognitive occlusion preventing abstract perception, and that his breakthrough was simultaneously a psychological healing and theological vindication.
key_claims: VALIS is Plotinus' One—the supreme undifferentiated reality from which all realms emanate
My 2-74 experience was anamnesis: remembering that reality is arranged morphologically at the Form level, not just experiencing a mystical state
Schizophrenia is a metaphysical condition—a sinking of the soul that occludes the ability to perceive abstractly and grasp essences
The soul fell into spatiotemporal imprisonment, locked into accidents; my breakthrough reversed this fall by restoring conceptual abstraction
My five or six realm hierarchy exactly matches Plotinus's hypostases—there is no system of human thought but Plotinus that accounts for my experience
Christianity was merely the mythological wrapper for my experience; the underlying world-structure is pure Neoplatonism
recurring_concepts: Realm hierarchy—spatiotemporal accidents realm (Realm 1, lowest), essence realm (Realm 3, illo tempore), Nous/Intelligence (Realm 2), the One (Realm 1, highest)
Anamnesis—recovery of forgotten knowledge that the morphological Form-world is real and ontologically prior
Metapsychosis—the soul's multiple incarnations are actually one essence-life in the trans-temporal realm
The Plasmate (Set)—identified as Plotinus' Nous, the intelligible realm ubiquitous but imperceptible
Essence vs. accidents—Plotinian distinction between Form reality and spatiotemporal multiplicity
The Fall of the soul—primordial descent into spatiotemporal imprisonment, reversible through noein (thinking/perceiving conceptually)
Coaxial/concentric realms—all realms interpenetrate; Rome AD 45 and USA 1974 are one at essence level
Abstraction as healing—schizophrenia is a failure of abstraction; recovery of abstract perception is recovery of spiritual consciousness
people_entities: Plotinus (3rd-century Neoplatonist philosopher; his system of emanation explains PKD's experience)
Plato (ancient Greek philosopher; source of Form theory and anamnesis doctrine)
Aristotle (ancient philosopher; contrasted with Plato on the reality of mathematicals and the structure of deity)
Heidegger (Martin Heidegger, 20th-century existentialist; source of Ur-Angst, Dasein, Geworfenheit, authenticity)
Eliade (Mircea Eliade, historian of religions; cited on shamanic cosmology and trans-cultural religious structure)
Paul (Apostle Paul; cited as source of Pauline Christianity, contrasted with Greek philosophy)
Olive Holt (PKD's mother-figure; represents 'bad' maternal authority in his repudiation narrative)
Thomas (PKD's 'true' name/self, achieved through overcoming maternal antagonism and authority)
St. Sophia (Divine Wisdom in Christian and Gnostic thought; mentioned as lacking in the demiurge)
texts_works: Ubik (PKD's novel; Platonist structure, depicting Nous and Form-realm reality)
VALIS (PKD's novel; two-source cosmogony showing the mother-bad/father-good dialectic)
The Hymn of the Pearl (Gnostic text; referenced for the letter motif and identity quest)
Plato's Parmenides (ancient philosophical dialogue; cited on how one idea is present in many particulars)
The Book of Acts (New Testament; appears in 'Tears' and functions via illo tempore)
Encyclopaedia Britannica article on Time (cited for Eucharist functioning outside spatiotemporal realm)
Encyclopaedia Britannica article on Plotinus (source of extensive quotations on hypostases, providence, intelligence)
autobiographical: I realized in February 1974 that the world is arranged morphologically, not just that it could be arranged that way—this was remembering, not learning
My brain underwent a quantum leap in perception and abstraction during 2-74; neural circuits fired involuntarily, triggering progressive abstraction
The xerox missive I received and my refusal to answer it were part of an illo tempore reperformance, a cosmic drama enacted in eternal time
I was told by maternal authority (Olive Holt) to answer the missive; my disobedience and repudiation of mother became my path to my true self (Thomas)
My good act regarding Covenant House allowed me to pass out of the sphere of necessity, vindicating Plotinian theodicy
I was previously locked in schizophrenic perception (lowest realm, multiplicity, chaos, entropy); my 2-74 breakthrough ceased my schizophrenia
I saw the .618034 doorway (golden ratio threshold?) closing, losing access to the Form realm's perceptual clarity in vision
I referenced these experiences in a Platt interview, discussing my recovery from schizophrenia during the 2-74 period
theological_motifs: The Fall—primordial descent of soul into spatiotemporal servitude and cognitive occlusion
Anamnesis—Platonic remembrance; recovery of essential knowledge buried by incarnational descent
Metapsychosis—reincarnation understood not as temporal succession but as essence-identity across apparent time
Theodicy—Plotinian defense that cosmic order assigns each soul its merited place; the wicked alone are enslaved to necessity
Illo tempore—primordial time outside space-time; the realm of archetypes and eternal reperformance
Providence—omnipresent divine order, not restricted to supralunar realm (vs. Aristotelian dualism)
Orphism—mystery religion tradition equating Christianity as latest successful mystery cult; shamanic cosmology
The Eucharist—sacrament functioning in illo tempore, bringing spatiotemporal participant into essence realm
Ur-Angst (Primal Anxiety)—Heideggerian authentic existential dread grounding awareness of authentic being
literary_self_ref: Ubik is Platonist, in fact Neoplatonist; Ubik being Nous (divine intelligence)
Ubik presents the Form axes correctly and prefigured my perception of morphological arrangement
VALIS contains my two-source cosmogony showing the mother-bad/father-good dialectic (my own repudiation pattern)
VALIS's depiction of the Plasmate (Set/Ground) corresponds to my 3-74 insight: Set is Plotinus' Nous
'Tears' features Acts appearing in illo tempore, functioning within the essence realm
My novels encoded Neoplatonic theology before I consciously understood I had experienced it
symbols_images: The xerox missive—a reperformed archetypal drama (letter motif from 'Hymn of the Pearl') testing obedience and identity
The golden ratio doorway (.618034)—threshold/border between spatiotemporal and Form realms, closing as PKD's vision faded
The Abyss—infinite space without time or change; the One's incomprehensible ground
Realm diagrams—PKD sketches a 5-6 level vertical axis from lowest (chaotic accidents) through essence realm to pure Nous to the One
Entropy and disorder—visual metaphor for multiplicity, fragmentation, schizophrenic chaos
Rome AD 45 and USA 1974—historical moments identical at essence level, revealing coaxial temporal architecture
The vertical axis—shamanic cosmology; three realms (lower, middle, upper) permitting spiritual ascent
tensions: PKD claims Neoplatonism is exclusively correct, yet cannot fully discount Christianity; acknowledges Christian symbols and Acts functioned in his experience
He identifies his experience as pure intellectual/perceptual abstraction, yet simultaneously ties it to involuntary neural firing and mystical phenomenology—mechanism vs. mysticism
He argues Gnosticism is wrong (rejects acosmism and evil demiurge) while admitting Gnostic overtones appear through Heidegger's Ur-Angst and the Fremdheit (alienation) motif
He claims his three-realm cosmology proves his system while acknowledging it has four or five or six levels depending on analysis
VALIS breaks the power of spatiotemporal determinism (Fate, Karma, DNA programming), yet Plotinian providence still assigns merited cosmic order—what is the residual freedom?
Schizophrenia is called ubiquitous (we all have it to some degree) yet PKD's breakthrough allegedly transcended it entirely—is healing possible for most?
evidence_quotes: I had just proved the reality (in fact superior ontology) of Plato's Form World, + didn't realize it.
There is no system of human thought (doctrine) but Plotinus where what happened to me - what my brain/mind did - is conceivable, is understood to exist.
the Plasmate (Set) that I saw as opposed to Ground is Plotinus' Nous (Intelligence) which is above the spatiotemporal realm; within it the Forms (phylogons) are morphologically arranged.
I was perceiving conceptually the Form world - essences morphologically arranged; hence much more order (negentropics + unity + reality (einai). + with einai came Nous, hence noein.
This all (Neo-Platonism) is why 3-74 most resembles 'Ubik' which is Platonist, in fact Neoplatonist. Ubik being Nous.
uncertainty_flags: What precisely is the .618034 doorway? PKD alludes to it (Fibonacci/golden ratio) but never explains it—possibly a visionary object whose meaning he struggled to articulate
The distinction between Realm #1 (One, void, infinite empty space) and Realm #4 or #5 is confusing; is PKD numbering from bottom-up or top-down inconsistently?
PKD cites Encyclopaedia Britannica on Plotinus as authority but provides no volume/date; these quotations cannot be independently verified
The claim that 'Tears' (which work? a published story?) features Acts in illo tempore is unclear—which novel or story is PKD referencing?
PKD asserts the xerox missive was an illo tempore reperformance but provides no external corroboration; is this his interpretation or documented fact?
The identification of VALIS with Plotinus' One is asserted but not argued in detail; how does VALIS as depicted in his novel map onto the impersonal absolute?

raw_text: I could not then extrapolate to the Essence (Form) realm in general. I.e. the next implication was lost to me; I failed to draw the next conclusion. I had just proved the reality (in fact superior ontology) of Plato's Form World, + didn't realize it. However, having made this quantum leap in mentation/perception-of-reality, I could not halt the involuntary chain of mental processes triggered off in my brain, which (i.e. my brain) had discovered that an ultra way of world-perception/experience/Dasein was possible - + more accurate - + so neural circuits fired + I proceded to progressively further & further abstract - think/see in categories of less spatiotemporality + more + more conceptual arrangement - the Xtian element was only a trigger/clue; this did not have to do with Xtianity per se but with abstracting of essentials at {folder 01 - 004 folder 01 - 004} the expense of accidents hence of spatiotemporal arrangement; as a result I ascended through the realms of neoplatonism - which makes VALIS Plotinus' One. There is no system of human thought (doctrine) but Plotinus where what happened to me - what my brain/mind did - is conceivable, is understood to exist. +: Plato + Plotinus teach that the soul somehow fell in the first place; they teach anamnesis; they teach metapsychosis; they teach not just the reality of the higher realms but their ontological priority - which is precisely what my brain grasped. It grasped not just that the einai realm was real - existed - but that it was more real, more correct a way of seeing + ordering, than the spatiotemporal accidents way. My brain did not consciously or fully extrapolate at least verbally. But it did extend its quantum-leap breakthrough insight into more of the same: it followed up its insight - it had no choice, knowing now what it knew: that a morphological arrangement of world took precedence over the spatiotemporal, knowledge lost a thousand or more years ago. + thereupon my pneuma/soul reacquired its forgotten lost nature, + the primordial fall - for me - was reversed. I ascended out of the spatiotemporal realm to divine life with God (as in Orphism: "Xtianity, the last + most {folder 01 - 005 folder 01 - 005} successful of the mystery religions" - + VALIS - God - did break the power of the spatiotemporal world over me, I mean astral determinism or Fate or Heimarmene or Karma or the sublunar realm or the planetary powers or the old law or DNA programming - this fired futilely into empty (non) time-+- space. This event, as Eliade points out, is trans-cultural + trans-doctrinal. All you really need to know is: 1) Lower realm (spatiotemporality) [Note A] 2) Upper realm (above space + time) 3) Vertical axis leading from (1) to (2). I.e. the universe of the shamans. This is e.g. what the Eucharist is supposed to do (v. the E.B.macro article on time). [Note A] + when this goes, so also goes causation. My 5 or 6 realm hierarchy is correct, but - is it Gnostic? No, it is Neo-Platonism because it has to do with (1) essence vs accidents; (2) the Form realm; (3) the supra-spatiotemporal; (4) the One. There is no suggestion of acosmism. Or of an evil demiurge. Oh yes there is a suggestion of Gnosticism: the Fremdheit of the spatiotemporal world -Geworfenheit- + the familiarity of the restoration-state: + the salvator salvandus. + Heidegger's Ur-Angst. + the dialectic is the war between God + the world (demiurge who {folder 01 - 006} lacks the a priori knowledge of St. Sophia. Plotinus/Gnosticism/Paulline Xtianity/Iranian influence: the dialectic. But if I had to chose I'd chose Plotinus. Plus Gnostic overtones due to Heidegger (esp. the Ur-Angst + the role, the crucial role, it plays in authentic being. I researched Plotinus; there is no doubt it is Neo-Platonist. No other doctrines are necessary nor do they apply. My 5 levels are his. Q.E.D. There was a Fall. - 4:30 a.m.: I didn't just realize world could be arranged (perceived) morphologically; I realized (2-74) that it is [in fact] arranged morphologically. Which is to say, I remembered. USA 1974 + Rome C. AD 45 are not tangent; they are at an essence (Form) level the same. This all (Neo-Platonism) is why 3-74 most resembles "Ubik" which is Platonist, in fact Neoplatonist. Ubik being Nous. So I now know the precise operation my brain performed in 2-74, what it recognized, the effects thereof + why, + what system of human thought it points to (Neo-Platonism). {folder 01 - 007 folder 01 - 007} I must not discount Xtianity; the Eucharist does function in terms of illo tempore (realm #3 the essence realm), + it is Acts that appears in "Tears". But the how it works - that is Neo-Platonism. + I did see several realms - + this plays no role in Xtianity. Xtianity was just the particular myth served up to me; the world-structure responsible was neo-platonist. +, specifically, it declares that the Form realm is not spatiotemporal, + that all realms are now + here: concentric (what I call "coaxial"). I conceptually grasped the underlying (essence realm) identity, etc. viz: arrangement by morphology (prefigured in "Ubik", the Form axes, correctly presented) which meant that the real arrangement lay outside the spatiotemporal in another realm or realms; this was anamnesis - connected to metapsychosis. + all the incarnations were one life in the Form realm - realm of essence: one essence life not in our kind of space-time (illo tempore). + with each ascending realm there is (as Plotinus taught) less multiplicity (hence more unity) until you come to the 2nd hypostasis, Nous + the purely abstract realm (Kosmos) which I saw; it is in Nous (Mind). The fully -+ radically- abstract this way meant a functional end to the schizophrenic impairment in me (the schizophrenic can't truly abstract): thus {folder 01 - 008 folder 01 - 008} it was a titanic psychological breakthrough as well. The term "schizophrenia" then, does apply to -refer to- a mental impairment or occlusion that locks you into the lowest realm, +, in extreme cases, the lowest level of the lowest realm. Thus I have adduced the spiritual implications of what we know of as "schizophrenia". (Lost in a world of chaotic accidents out of which no sense -order- can be made. Entropy, too.) (Entropy = disorder = proportional to multiplicity.) The Fall of the soul -as I have long speculated- does tie in with an occlusion of cognition + perception that I have of late come to identify with schizophrenia; I now see specifically that it has to do with impairment in the ability to perceptually abstract. We all have it to some degree. My ability to perceive the world-order abstractly is why I said: "I am no longer blind!" I was perceiving conceptually the Form world - essences morphologically arranged; hence much more order (negentropics + unity + reality (einai). + with einai came Nous, hence noein (Heidegger is right). (Plato, in describing the Form Realm, is describing a realm now lost to human perception due to a further sinking of the soul.) The intermediate illo tempore essence world carries vast space + time. Because it is extensive over 1000s of years + 1000s of miles it can be {folder 01 - 009 folder 01 - 009} said to exist in eternity because that is how such vast space-time would seem to us. Also (+ this must not be forgotten) one archetypal situation (drama) is timelessly performed (or, to use our Realm #4 term, reperformed). The xerox missive must have been -or at least seemed to me to be at the time- part of the (or a) illo tempore reperformance. The letter in "The Hymn of the Pearl"? Olive Holt = my [ideological/identity] parent[s]. Hence I came to my true self Thomas, because my relationship to my parents is one of repudiation + rebellion: antagonism. + specifically disobedience; refusal to do what I'm told to do (I was told to answer the xerox missive). (More precisely: Mother - Bad. Father - Good. Olive Holt = Mother.) (This dichotomy shows up in my two source cosmogony in "Valis".) So I ceased to be schizophrenic in 2-74, as I pondered in the Platt interview. But here by "schizophrenia" I mean a ubiquitous impairment, "the sinking of the soul". No wonder my breakthrough recently that led to these conclusions had to do with perception of a metastructure of which we normally see only the discrete components! (Since it all has to do with abstracting.) The occlusion that I first detected in 1971 is real + it is ubiquitous. [illustration presented below in text form small limited..vast space +.....abstract -.....The One: space + time...time: eternity...no space-time..the void- so Realm 4........Realm 3..........Realm 2........something ...............................................like space ..............................................Realm 1 {folder 01 - 010 folder 01 - 010} In Realm #1 space -infinite amounts, + empty- reappears, but not time. + in each higher realm not only does multiplicity decrease but also change. Until you wind up with infinite space (the Abyss) + no change, i.e. no time. Apparently realms #3 + #2 are conceptual but realm #1 -the One- is not. Nous exists in #2, not #1. Nous (#2) is the One become self-aware + hence split (I think). Anyhow it is differentiated, but still unified (Valis). E of Ph on Plotinus: "According to Aristotle, Plato had assumed a realm of Mathematicals mediating between ideas [Form world] + sensibles [accidents world] - a doctrine Aristotle related to a similar, equally dualistic doctrine of the Pythagoreans." I saw this realm: Esp. the .618034 doorway which must have led from our spatiotemporal accidental realm to the Form realm, + that doorway was closing + I could no longer see the upper realm after that. "Aristotle designated the supreme deity as Intelligence (Nous) contemplating itself." "Plotinus subdivided Plato's realm of intelligibles into 3: the One, Intelligence (Nous) + the Soul "Plotinus tries to show that just because Intelligence + Soul are not extended, they can be omnipresent + ubiquitous in what is extended" [the spatiotemporal realm]. "The most striking example of the real effects of the Soul's falling away from Intelligence is that the cosmic soul, as it falls away, engenders time because of an inability to contemplate the totality of Intelligence simultaneously." {folder 01 - 011} "Plotinus taught that the cosmic order rewards + punishes everyone according to his merits + assigns each one an appropriate place" (Theodicy.) "Plotinus insists on the all-pervasive character of providence, thus rejecting Aristotle's dichotomy of the universe into a sublunar sphere dominated by necessity + a supralunar world to which providence is restricted: only the wicked are subject to necessity." [Thus by my good act vis-a-vis Covenant House I passed out of the sphere of necessity.] "Both Intelligence + Soul are supposed to be present in the sensible world +, therefore, present in what is extended, although they themselves are not extended. Starting with the famous discussion in Plato's 'Parmenides', in which the attempt is made to explain how one idea can be present in many particulars, Plotinus tries to show that just because "Intelligence + Soul are not extended, they can be omnipresent + ubiquitous in what is extended." This refers precisely to my Set/Ground "two signal" "metastructure" "exploded" perception (3-74) insight (during the last few days) + identifies my experience as Neoplatonist + not Gnostic - nor anything else (i.e. my 4, 5 or 6 realms) (which are here; but we see only the discrete plurality of constituents.) So in 3-74 the Plasmate (Set) that I saw as opposed to Ground is Plotinus' Nous (Intelligence) which is above the spatiotemporal realm; within it the Forms (phylogons) are morphologically arranged. It is [indeed] {folder 01 - 012 folder 01 - 012} here ubiquitously in the spatiotemporal world but we can't discriminate it normally. In no way does Gnosticism account for my experience. The E.B.
